messages:
anya.partnerships: Heads up 101 - we're lining up a joint marketplace launch with FlowForge + LangChain integrations next month. Need alignment on cert matrix, gateway adapter naming, and the co-announcement timeline. tagging platform + marketing + legal.

nate.platform: +1. critical: cert matrix must include runtime compatibility (v2 connector), auth flow (pass-through vs delegated tokens), and a small perf profile (p50/p95) for our Dedicated tier.

dev.ops: on the adapter naming 141 - partners are shipping their own Helm charts. we should agree a label convention so our observability and the marketplace UI can auto-detect integrations. propose label: `redwood.integration=flowforge` and `redwood.adapter.version=1.0.0`.

anya.partnerships: good idea. also want to avoid confusion between "gateway" (partner-managed) and "connector" (marketplace provided). maybe standardize: partner-managed = Gateway, marketplace install = Connector.

ashley.marketing: for co-announcement we need a 3-week lead: assets (one-pager, blog draft, social), a joint webinar, and a customer case (even beta). Can product/eng confirm launch readiness date?

nate.platform: engineering target for cert tests: two weeks for smoke tests + one week for perf run. so we can aim for readiness in 3 weeks if partner tests go smooth.

ellen.evangelism: I'll capture SDK snippets for LangChain and LlamaIndex adapters. Quick ask: which call signature do we want to recommend? LangChain's agent-style vs direct llm.generate. I'd prefer recommending both with examples.

anya.partnerships: include both. partners often want the higher-level agent example for demos and the lower-level call for production.

paul.legal: When you say marketplace listing, we need to confirm data flow language and liability. Two items: (1) telemetry (usage metrics) must be opt-in by partner for co-marketing dashboards, and (2) clear billing attribution wording if customers move from trial to paid. I'll draft minimal required clauses.

dev.ops: small tech note: for Helm-based connectors we should surface a `redwood.metrics.endpoint` and `redwood.partner-id` values in values.yaml so our ingress can pick them up automatically. snippet: ```yaml
labels:
  redwood.integration: "flowforge"
  redwood.partner-id: "pf_001"
annotations:
  redwood.metrics.endpoint: "https://metrics.redwood.ai/push"
```

ellen.evangelism: perfect, I'll add that to the quickstart. also planning a short demo repo with both LangChain and LlamaIndex examples calling the Connector via gateway.

anya.partnerships: action items: 1) eng (nate/dev.ops) -> agree label/values and provide cert test checklist + perf harness by EOD Friday; 2) product/evangelism -> snippets, quickstart, and demo repo (ellen) by next Tue; 3) marketing -> draft co-announcement timeline and asset list (ashley); 4) legal -> marketplace listing clauses (paul).

announce-bot: Reminder: weekly partnerships sync in 2 hours (channel: #partnerships).

ashley.marketing: I'll ping partners to confirm webinar dates and request a short beta quote for the blog.

nate.platform: opening a repo `marketplace/flowforge-connector` and a PR for the values.yaml pattern now. will tag reviewers.

anya.partnerships: thanks all. small ask: if partner wants an honorarium for the beta customer case, flag it now and we'll handle budget with sales.
